text: it depends very much on the clerk and the branch. while some might be more understanding i had friends that didnt even reach the 90 days (90 days is not written in any way, but "center of life", most branches interpret it) and MH didnt want to extend their visa or only give them a 3 month extension. the war is not really an excuse for them as there was a way in and out of country. if you have a good reason (family emergency etc) it might help.
